title: WPC Product Options for WooCommerce before 4.0.9 contains a price manipulation vulnerability that allows…
description: WPC Product Options for WooCommerce versions prior to 4.0.9 contains a vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate product prices during the add-to-cart process. By submitting specially crafted option data with negative prices, attackers can cause the system to accept arbitrary prices, including zero, for products at checkout.
